hutaomod.soul_butterfly_lamp.title: Soul-Calling Butterfly Lamp
hutaomod.soul_butterfly_lamp.description: When an enemy dies, heal HP equal to its remaining Blood Blossom stacks.
hutaomod.soul_butterfly_lamp.flavor: A lamp from the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. The butterflies know the way home.
hutaomod.plum_brazier.title: Plum Blossom Brazier
hutaomod.plum_brazier.description: At the start of combat, apply 2 Blood Blossom to ALL enemies.
hutaomod.plum_brazier.flavor: The incense of plum blossoms drifts where the living dare not go.
hutaomod.requiem_candle.title: Requiem Candle
hutaomod.requiem_candle.description: At the start of combat, lose 3 HP and gain 2 Strength.
hutaomod.requiem_candle.flavor: Candlelight burns at both ends - just like its owner.
